The MAN 49/60DF is future-proof 
in multiple ways. Its benchmark fuel 
efficiency guarantees competitive 
vessel operation. The very low level of
methane emissions ensures long-term 
CO2 equivalent emission compliance. 
A modern engine platform with 
next-generation engine automation 
system can harness the benefits of 
a digitized marine operation. For this 
platform MAN Energy Solutions plans 
upgrades to future fuels.
Benefits at a glance
– Benchmark efficiency
– Very low methane emissions
– Robust performance in gas mode 
based on next-generation 
combustion control ACC 2.0
– Next-generation engine automation 
ready for future tasks such as 
cybersecurity
– Compact design by increased 
power densityL1

– Engine cycle: four-stroke
– No. of cylinders: 6L, 7L, 8L, 9L, 10L

– Gas mode: 6,990 kJ/kWh

– Gas mode: IMO Tier III
– Liquid mode: IMO Tier II,

– Gas and liquid mode: 
Fuel EU maritime

Turbocharging system

Engine automation and control 
– Next-generation in-house

– Next-generation combustion control
Fuel system 
– Cylinder individual solenoid gas 
admission valves for gas injection 
into charge air
– Next-generation MAN Common Rail

or HFO, developed in-house

Cooling system 
– 2-string high and low temperature 
cooling water systems or alternatively
a combined cooling water system

– Starting air valves within 
cylinder heads
Engine mounting 
– Resilient or rigid mounting

– Additional insulation for maximum

– High levels of cybersecurity
